import humanize.time as time_mod

delta_days = 31
days = delta_days
secs = 0
usecs = 0

min_unit = time_mod.Unit.SECONDS
suppress_set = set()
# Simulate _suppress_lower_units
for unit in time_mod.Unit:
    if unit == min_unit:
        break
    suppress_set.add(unit)
print(f'suppress_set: {suppress_set}')

MILLISECONDS = time_mod.Unit.MILLISECONDS
SECONDS = time_mod.Unit.SECONDS
MINUTES = time_mod.Unit.MINUTES
HOURS = time_mod.Unit.HOURS
DAYS = time_mod.Unit.DAYS
MONTHS = time_mod.Unit.MONTHS
YEARS = time_mod.Unit.YEARS

years, days = time_mod._quotient_and_remainder(days, 365, YEARS, min_unit, suppress_set, '%0.2f')
print(f'After years: years={years}, days={days}')

months, days = time_mod._quotient_and_remainder(days, 30.5, MONTHS, min_unit, suppress_set, '%0.2f')
print(f'After months: months={months}, days={days}')

secs = days * 24 * 3600 + secs
days, secs = time_mod._quotient_and_remainder(secs, 24 * 3600, DAYS, min_unit, suppress_set, '%0.2f')
print(f'After days->hours: days={days}, secs={secs}')

hours, secs = time_mod._quotient_and_remainder(secs, 3600, HOURS, min_unit, suppress_set, '%0.2f')
print(f'After hours: hours={hours}, secs={secs}')

minutes, secs = time_mod._quotient_and_remainder(secs, 60, MINUTES, min_unit, suppress_set, '%0.2f')
print(f'After minutes: minutes={minutes}, secs={secs}')

usecs = secs * 1e6 + usecs
secs, usecs = time_mod._quotient_and_remainder(usecs, 1e6, SECONDS, min_unit, suppress_set, '%0.2f')
print(f'After seconds: secs={secs}, usecs={usecs}')

msecs, usecs = time_mod._quotient_and_remainder(usecs, 1000, MILLISECONDS, min_unit, suppress_set, '%0.2f')
print(f'After milliseconds: msecs={msecs}, usecs={usecs}')

import humanize.time as tm

for days in [29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 61, 62, 63]:
    suppress_set = {tm.Unit.MICROSECONDS, tm.Unit.MILLISECONDS}
    min_unit = tm.Unit.SECONDS
    
    months, d = tm._quotient_and_remainder(days, 30.5, tm.Unit.MONTHS, min_unit, suppress_set, '%0.2f')
    
    # Proposed fix
    new_months = int(months)
    new_days = d
    if d >= 0.5 and int(new_months) == new_months:
        new_days -= 0.5
        new_months += 1
    
    print(f'{days}d: orig={months:.1f}, rem={d}, fixed={new_months}m {new_days}d')

import humanize
import datetime as dt

for days in [29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35]:
    # Test with my simple fix: zero out days if <= 0.5 and months > 0
    suppress_set = {humanize.time.Unit.MICROSECONDS, humanize.time.Unit.MILLISECONDS}
    min_unit = humanize.time.Unit.SECONDS
    
    delta_days = days
    delta = dt.timedelta(days=delta_days)
    
    date, delta_obj = humanize.time._date_and_delta(delta, precise=True)
    suppress_set = humanize.time._suppress_lower_units(min_unit, set())
    
    years, days_rem = humanize.time._quotient_and_remainder(
        delta.days, 365, humanize.time.Unit.YEARS, min_unit, suppress_set, '%0.2f')
    months, days = humanize.time._quotient_and_remainder(
        days_rem, 30.5, humanize.time.Unit.MONTHS, min_unit, suppress_set, '%0.2f')
    
    # Apply fix
    if months > 0 and days <= 0.5:
        days = 0.0
    
    # Continue conversion to get hours etc.
    secs = days * 24 * 3600 + delta.seconds
    days, secs = humanize.time._quotient_and_remainder(
        secs, 24*3600, humanize.time.Unit.DAYS, min_unit, suppress_set, '%0.2f')
    
    hours, secs = humanize.time._quotient_and_remainder(
        secs, 3600, humanize.time.Unit.HOURS, min_unit, suppress_set, '%0.2f')
    
    minutes, secs = humanize.time._quotient_and_remainder(
        secs, 60, humanize.time.Unit.MINUTES, min_unit, suppress_set, '%0.2f')
    
    print(f'{days}d -> m={months}, d={days}, h={hours}, m={minutes}')

import datetime as dt
from freezegun import freeze_time

with freeze_time('2010-02-02'):
    today = dt.date.today()
    value = dt.date(2009, 2, 2)
    delta = value - today
    print(f'value: {value}, today: {today}')
    print(f'delta: {delta}, days: {delta.days}')
    print(f'5 * 365 / 12 = {5 * 365 / 12}')
    print(f'delta.days >= 5*365/12: {delta.days >= 5 * 365 / 12}')

# Now let's see what happens with _abs_timedelta
print()
print('With _abs_timedelta:')
with freeze_time('2010-02-02'):
    from humanize.time import _abs_timedelta
    delta = _abs_timedelta(value - today)
    print(f'delta after _abs_timedelta: {delta}, days: {delta.days}')
    print(f'delta.days >= 5*365/12: {delta.days >= 5 * 365 / 12}')

import datetime as dt
from freezegun import freeze_time
import humanize.time as ht

with freeze_time('2010-02-02'):
    original_value = dt.date(2009, 2, 2)
    print(f'original_value: {original_value}')
    
    today = dt.date.today()
    print(f'today: {today}')
    
    value = dt.date(original_value.year, original_value.month, original_value.day)
    print(f'value after creating date: {value}')
    
    delta_raw = value - today
    print(f'delta_raw: {delta_raw}, days: {delta_raw.days}')
    
    delta = ht._abs_timedelta(delta_raw)
    print(f'delta after _abs_timedelta: {delta}, days: {delta.days}')
    
    threshold = 5 * 365 / 12
    print(f'threshold: {threshold}')
    print(f'delta.days >= threshold: {delta.days >= threshold}')

from freezegun import freeze_time
import humanize.time as ht
import datetime as dt

with freeze_time('2010-02-02'):
    today = dt.date.today()
    value = dt.date(2009, 1, 2)
    delta = value - today
    
    print(f'today: {today}')
    print(f'value: {value}')
    print(f'delta: {delta}, days: {delta.days}')
    
    threshold = 5 * 365 // 12
    print(f'5 * 365 // 12 = {threshold}')
    print(f'-{threshold} = {-threshold}')
    print(f'delta.days < -{threshold}: {delta.days < -threshold}')
    print(f'delta.days > {threshold}: {delta.days > threshold}')

import datetime as dt

# With frozen time 2010-02-02
today = dt.date(2010, 2, 2)

# Test different 'ago' durations
test_dates = [
    (2009, 3, 2),   # Should be ~1 month ago (~Feb has 28 days, so ~39 days? No wait, Mar->Feb)
    (2009, 4, 2),   # ~2 months ago
    (2009, 5, 2),   # ~3 months ago
    (2009, 6, 2),   # ~4 months ago
    (2009, 7, 2),   # ~5 months ago
    (2009, 8, 2),   # ~6 months ago  
    (2009, 9, 2),   # ~7 months ago
]

for y, m, d in test_dates:
    value = dt.date(y, m, d)
    delta = value - today
    print(f'{y}-{m:02d}-{d}: delta = {delta.days} days ({abs(delta.days)/30:.1f} months back)')
